changelog:
- Major update to v2.0.2 with unified API via Craft MCP v2 (`craft_write` / `craft_read`).
- All document creation, editing, and formatting now handled through a single command interface.
- JSON mode strongly recommended for all structured or special content; markdown mode limited to simple text.
- Safer production usage guidance added, with rollback best practices.
- Expanded documentation with detailed block and element mappings, input modes, and indentation/nesting rules.
- Changelog covers new default workflows, code block handling, toggle content, and Craft link resolution.
summary: Create and format Craft documents reliably via the Craft MCP v2 unified API (craft_write / craft_read). Triggers on any Craft document or note creation, edit...
